% ======================================================================
% 01_titlepage.tex: the cover page (printed twice: hard cover and soft cover)
% DO NOT EDIT THE TEXT HERE. Every name on the cover comes from info.txt:
%   \ministry, \universitylineone/two, \faculty, \thesistype, \thesistitle,
%   \supervisor, \authorname, \studentid, \studentclass, \cohort, \coverdate.
% To change a name, edit the matching line in info.txt.
% Images: figures/border_frame.png (page border) and figures/logo.jpg (logo).
%   Replace figures/logo.jpg with your own logo, keeping the file name (any size, it is scaled to 35% of the text width).
% To change sizes or spacing on the cover, edit the \fontsize{..}{..} values and the [..cm] gaps below.
% The \newgeometry line gives equal left and right margins so the text is centred inside the border.
% ======================================================================

\newgeometry{left=20mm, right=20mm}

\begin{titlepage}
    \centering

    % Border image, inset 7 mm from each paper edge.
    \begin{tikzpicture}[remember picture, overlay]
        \node at (current page.center) {%
            \includegraphics[
                width=\dimexpr\paperwidth-14mm\relax,
                height=\dimexpr\paperheight-14mm\relax
            ]{figures/border_frame.png}%
        };
    \end{tikzpicture}

    % ---- Institution ----
    {\fontsize{14pt}{16pt}\selectfont\textbf{\ministry}}\\[0.25cm]
    {\fontsize{14pt}{18pt}\selectfont
        \textbf{\universitylineone}\\
        \textbf{\universitylinetwo}}\\[0.25cm]
    {\fontsize{13pt}{15pt}\selectfont\textbf{————————————}}\\[0.5cm]
    {\fontsize{16pt}{18pt}\selectfont\textbf{\faculty}}\\[1.2cm]

    \includegraphics[width=0.35\textwidth]{figures/logo.jpg}\\[2cm]

    % ---- Thesis ----
    {\fontsize{30pt}{34pt}\selectfont\textbf{\thesistype}}\\[0.8cm]
    {\fontsize{16pt}{20pt}\selectfont\textbf{\thesistitle}}\\[2.1cm]

    % ---- Supervisor and student ----
    {\fontsize{13pt}{15pt}\selectfont
    \begin{tabular}{@{}l l@{}}
        \textbf{Supervisor:} & \textbf{\supervisor} \\
        \textbf{Student:} &
        \begin{tabular}[t]{@{}l l@{}}
            \textbf{\authorname}            & \quad \textbf{Student ID: \studentid} \\
            \textbf{Class: \studentclass}   & \quad \textbf{Cohort: \cohort}
        \end{tabular}
    \end{tabular}}

    \vfill

    {\fontsize{13pt}{14pt}\selectfont\textbf{\coverdate}}\\[0.3cm]
\end{titlepage}

\restoregeometry
